Please identify the passage (preferably its DK reference), the selected translation, and the issue. For a proposed textual or bibliographical correction, include the edition and page or a source link. For a technical problem, include the browser and steps needed to reproduce it.

Issues are public. Please do not include passwords, private contact details or other sensitive information.
